final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.team_id, AVG(CAST(m.w AS REAL) / NULLIF(m.g, 0)) AS win_rate, COUNT(m.player_id) AS manager_count FROM team AS t LEFT JOIN manager_half AS m ON t.team_id COLLATE BINARY = m.team_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.team_id), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(win_rate) AS overall_rate FROM step1) SELECT step1.team_id, step1.win_rate, step1.manager_count, step1.win_rate - step2.overall_rate FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY step1.win_rate - step2.overall_rate DESC LIMIT 10
